title: Send tool_choice auto to Claude models that reject a forced tool

@@ -11,6 +11,36 @@ class Provider::Anthropic < Provider
   # All Claude 3.5+ and 4.x models accept native document content blocks.
   VISION_CAPABLE_MODEL_PREFIXES = %w[claude].freeze
 
+  # Claude 3.x, 4.x and Haiku 5.5 accept a forced `tool_choice`. Anything else
+  # gets `auto` (Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 reject a forced
+  # one), so a model released after this line still works. Matches anywhere in
+  # the ID to cover Bedrock (`anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-…-v1:0`) and Vertex
+  # (`claude-sonnet-4-5@…`) IDs.
+  FORCED_TOOL_CHOICE_MODELS = /claude-(?:3|(?:opus|sonnet|haiku)-4|haiku-5[-.]5)(?!\d)/
+
+  def self.forced_tool_choice_supported?(model)
+    model.to_s.match?(FORCED_TOOL_CHOICE_MODELS)
+  end
+
+  # The tool_choice for a helper that returns its result through a single tool.
+  # Models that can't be forced get `auto`, paired with structured_output_system.
+  def self.structured_output_tool_choice(model, tool_name)
+    if forced_tool_choice_supported?(model)
+      { type: "tool", name: tool_name, disable_parallel_tool_use: true }
+    else
+      { type: "auto", disable_parallel_tool_use: true }
+    end
+  end
+
+  # The system prompt for a helper that returns its result through a single tool.
+  # With `auto`, a family's prompt override may not mention the tool, so a fixed
+  # instruction to call it is appended.
+  def self.structured_output_system(instructions, model, tool_name)
+    return instructions if forced_tool_choice_supported?(model)
+
+    "#{instructions}\n\nReturn the result by calling the #{tool_name} tool. Do not answer with text."
+  end
+

     # lookup is only performed when the ENV var is actually absent — otherwise

@@ -199,7 +199,7 @@ How it differs from the OpenAI-compatible provider:
   - **Every provider:** below `4096`, the chat's system prompt lists accounts and categories only as counts, and the model fetches them with tools.
   - **OpenAI-compatible:** it is also the budget, with `LLM_MAX_RESPONSE_TOKENS` and `LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT_RESERVE`, for splitting auto-categorization and merchant batches, and for trimming chat history on Chat Completions endpoints (`LLM_MAX_HISTORY_TOKENS`). The native OpenAI Responses API keeps history on OpenAI's side, so nothing is trimmed there.
   - **Native Anthropic:** only the system-prompt check applies. History is sent whole, batches aren't split, and `LLM_MAX_RESPONSE_TOKENS`, `LLM_MAX_HISTORY_TOKENS` and `LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT_RESERVE` are ignored. Set `LLM_CONTEXT_WINDOW` by env (e.g. `200000`) so the prompt lists accounts and categories; its UI field is in the OpenAI panel.
-- **The reply limit is always sent.** A reply that needs more than `ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS` is cut off. Only bank statement extraction detects this (it logs a warning). Raise the limit if long answers or batch results come back incomplete.
+- **The reply limit is always sent.** A reply that needs more than `ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS` is cut off, and on Claude 5 models the model's thinking counts toward it. Only bank statement extraction detects this (it logs a warning). Raise the limit if long answers or batch results come back incomplete.
 - **Batch size.** Auto-categorization, merchant detection and merchant enhancement send `LLM_MAX_ITEMS_PER_CALL` items per request (default `25`), with no splitting to fit the context window. Raise `ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS` along with it, or replies are cut off (see [Where AI jobs run](#where-ai-jobs-run-sidekiq-lanes)).
 - **Its own timeout.** `ANTHROPIC_REQUEST_TIMEOUT` replaces `OPENAI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT`. `AI_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT` still covers the whole chat turn. `OPENAI_EXTRA_HEADERS`, `LLM_JSON_MODE` and `OPENAI_SUPPORTS_*` don't apply.

+require "test_helper"
+require "ostruct"
+
+class Provider::Anthropic::BillSetupSuggesterTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
+  setup do
+    @charges = [
+      { date: "2026-08-03", amount: 15.49, name: "NETFLIX.COM" },
+      { date: "2026-09-03", amount: 15.49, name: "NETFLIX.COM" }
+    ]
+    @categories = [ "Subscriptions", "Utilities" ]
+  end
+
+  test "issues a forced tool call and maps the suggestion" do
+    client = stub_client(build_response(content: [ suggestion_block ]), expect_request: ->(params) {
+      assert_equal "claude-haiku-4-5", params[:model]
+      assert_equal({ type: "tool", name: "report_bill_setup", disable_parallel_tool_use: true }, params[:tool_choice])
+      assert_equal "report_bill_setup", params[:tools].first[:name]
+      assert_not_includes params[:system_], "Do not answer with text."
+    })
+
+    result = suggester(client, model: "claude-haiku-4-5").suggest
+
+    assert_suggestion result
+  end
+
+  test "sends tool_choice auto to a model that rejects a forced tool" do
+    client = stub_client(build_response(content: [ suggestion_block ]), expect_request: ->(params) {
+      assert_equal({ type: "auto", disable_parallel_tool_use: true }, params[:tool_choice])
+      assert_includes params[:system_], "calling the report_bill_setup tool"
+    })
+
+    result = suggester(client, model: "claude-sonnet-5-5").suggest
+
+    assert_suggestion result
+  end
+
+  test "raises with the stop reason when the model returns no tool_use" do
+    response = build_response(content: [ OpenStruct.new(type: :text, text: "Looks monthly.") ])
+    response.stop_reason = :end_turn
+
+    err = assert_raises(Provider::Anthropic::Error) do
+      suggester(stub_client(response), model: "claude-sonnet-5-5").suggest
+    end
+
+    assert_match(/did not invoke report_bill_setup \(stop_reason: end_turn\)/, err.message)
+  end
+
+  private
+    def suggester(client, model:)
+      Provider::Anthropic::BillSetupSuggester.new(client, model: model, charges: @charges, categories: @categories)
+    end
+
+    def assert_suggestion(result)
+      assert_equal "Netflix", result.name
+      assert_equal 15.49, result.amount
+      assert_equal "monthly", result.frequency
+      assert_equal 3, result.day_of_month
+      assert_equal "Subscriptions", result.category_name
+      assert_equal "subscription", result.bill_type
+      assert_nil result.autopay
+    end
+
+    def suggestion_block
+      OpenStruct.new(
+        type: :tool_use,
+        id: "toolu_1",
+        name: "report_bill_setup",
+        input: {
+          "name" => "Netflix",
+          "amount" => 15.49,
+          "frequency" => "monthly",
+          "day_of_month" => 3,
+          "weekday" => nil,
+          "month_of_year" => nil,
+          "category_name" => "Subscriptions",
+          "bill_type" => "subscription",
+          "autopay" => nil,
+          "confidence" => 0.9,
+          "rationale" => "Same charge on the 3rd of each month."
+        }
+      )
+    end
+
+    def stub_client(response, expect_request: nil)
+      messages = mock
+      if expect_request
+        messages.expects(:create).with do |params|
+          expect_request.call(params)
+          true
+        end.returns(response)
+      else
+        messages.stubs(:create).returns(response)
+      end
+      client = mock
+      client.stubs(:messages).returns(messages)
+      client
+    end
+
+    def build_response(content:)
+      OpenStruct.new(
+        id: "msg_test",
+        model: "claude-haiku-4-5",
+        content: content,
+        usage: OpenStruct.new(input_tokens: 120, output_tokens: 60)
+      )
+    end
+end
